title: Ed Barker (Studio 1878) on filming Eric at Startup Day Seattle
summary: Studio 1878 founder and former VC Ed Barker films a Seattle AI Society short with Eric at Startup Day and captures the launch framing in 62-like reach.
blockquote: Eric proposes building "mission-controlled" companies with strong "governance exoskeletons" to preserve values and reframe profit as human flourishing. In a time of value concentration, shitcoins and short-term corporate thinking, it's a timely message.
attribution_title: Founder, Studio 1878 (1,500+ podcast episodes); former VC
